prompt:
A vertical, ultra-photorealistic night-time fashion portrait of an elegant woman with sleek, glossy dark-brown hair parted cleanly and falling over her shoulders. She wears a tailored, sleeveless square-neckline mini dress in vibrant saffron-marigold crepe, accentuating clean architectural lines. Her right arm rests naturally on the smooth teak armrest of a modern lounge armchair,displaying a bold polished-brass sculpted cuff bracelet, a minimalist gemstone ring, and long manicured nails in deep glossy plum. Her left arm rests across the other armrest, styled with a slender emerald-green cord bracelet paired alongside an elegant rose-gold mesh-strap watch. She sits poised with her body angled slightly toward the camera, seated comfortably on deep navy-blue plush cushions set into the warm wooden chair frame.The scene unfolds on a breezy upscale open-air rooftop terrace with dark hardwood deck flooring under the night sky. In the far background, glowing amber string lights, soft candle-lit restaurant tables, and softly blurred silhouettes of distant lounge patrons melt into a rich, creamy bokeh. Warm ambient lantern glow highlights her dewy skin texture, natural pores, collarbones, and subtle smile.Captured on a full-frame 85mm f/1.4 lens, low-light photography, ISO 800, razor-sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, no logos, no text, no watermarks.
--ar 9:16

promptZh:
一张竖构图、超写实主义的夜间时尚人像，主角是一位优雅的女性，留着 顺滑、有光泽的深棕色 头发，中分发型自然垂落在肩头。她身穿一件剪裁合身的无袖方领迷你连衣裙，材质为 鲜艳的藏红花万寿菊色 绉纱，凸显出简洁的建筑线条感。她的右臂自然地搭在现代休闲扶手椅光滑的柚木扶手上，佩戴着一款大胆的抛光黄铜雕塑感手镯、一枚极简风格宝石戒指，指甲修剪整齐并涂有深色亮面李子色指甲油。她的左臂横跨在另一侧扶手上，手腕上叠戴着一条纤细的翠绿色绳编手链和一块优雅的玫瑰金网带腕表。她姿态端庄，身体微微转向镜头，舒适地坐在嵌入暖色木质椅架的深海军蓝毛绒坐垫上。场景设定在一个 微风习习的高端露天屋顶露台，地面铺设着深色硬木地板，上方是静谧的夜空。远景中，闪烁的琥珀色串灯、柔和的烛光餐桌以及远处休闲客人的模糊剪影融合成浓郁、奶油般的虚化背景。温暖的灯笼光影映衬出她水润的肌肤质感、自然的毛孔、锁骨以及淡淡的微笑。使用全画幅 85mm f/1.4 镜头拍摄，低光摄影，ISO 800，主体对焦锐利，浅景深，电影级调色，无 Logo，无文字，无水印。
--ar 9:16
